hero.title: Born in a Parking Lot, Built on Fire
hero.subtitle: Smoke & Stack started with one smoker, one griddle, and a stubborn belief that Austin deserved better burgers and better brisket in the same bite.

story.title: From Food Trailer to Austin Institution

paragraphs.0: Smoke & Stack fired up its first smoker behind a gas station on South Congress in 2016. Pitmaster Dale Reyes was smoking brisket at 4am and flipping smash burgers by lunch, and word got around fast — the line wrapped the block before we even had a sign.
paragraphs.1: We never set out to pick a lane between Texas barbecue and all-American burgers. We figured if you love food enough, you don't have to choose. So we built a menu that runs post oak smoked brisket right alongside a double smash patty with griddle-crisped edges, because Austin eats big and Austin eats both.
paragraphs.2: Today we run three kitchens across the city, but the process hasn't changed: brisket still goes on at midnight, patties still get smashed to order, and every ticket still gets packed like it's going to your own kitchen table. Order online for pickup or delivery and taste why the line started in the first place.
